Lida Anne 17 wks.

description: A black and white mid-century snapshot featuring a 17-week-old baby girl named Lida Anne lying on her stomach on a bed. A clear round toy or rattle rests beside her on the bed sheet as natural sunlight streams across the scene from a nearby window. Taken in August 1950, this photo captures an intimate family moment from the post-World War II American Baby Boom era. The print features classic deckle edges.
